scope: Focused visual review of the added K80 quick-response concealed sprinkler temperature photographs after the passing browser checks.

observations: The lower photograph section displays a consistent three-column desktop grid.
The 57°C covered and exposed samples appear first, followed by the 68°C pair.
White backgrounds, complete product outlines and factory labels are retained.
CHUANWEI FIRE watermarks occupy clear background space and captions are readable.
The final 141°C covered and exposed samples are displayed in the expected order.
The exposed blue-bulb sample is fully visible inside its mobile card.
Arabic captions and the enlarge link wrap inside the card without clipping or horizontal overflow.
The photograph section ends before the independent configuration section.
